what: The SHAPE of X-Rite i1Profiler 3.8.6's i1Pro 2 dual-scan requests, from two owners' USB recordings (2026-11-17; the recordings themselves are private and not in the repository). Only request codes, measurement flags, integration and lamp clock counts and reading counts: the protocol's public form, as docs/design and native/instlib/cq_tscan.h already publish the table's recorded lines. No instrument data, no EEPROM bytes, no serial.

dual_calibration_tail.source: instrument 1, hand-held session 204244 step 2 (and 210339); instrument 2 on the i1iO 2 table, 22:14:49 (the same tail at 139 clocks)
i1profiler_also_sends_which_chromiq_does: 0xC4 / 0xC3: 2 EEPROM reads and 10 EEPROM writes (its usage log)
0xD6 + bulk 0x03: an 18-byte light program before and a 2,306-byte one after the calibration

per_strip.note: lamp + scan + ruler start; the scan runs while the button is held (440-560 readings)
UV LED + scan + ruler end, about 4.3 s (slow 6.5 s) after the lamp pass

dual_strip_by_hand.ruler: one continuous stream on endpoint 0x85 from the lamp pass's trigger to the end of the UV pass
i1profiler_also_sends_which_chromiq_does: 0xD6 + bulk 0x03: a 702-byte light program between the passes and a 2,990-byte one after the UV pass

dual_spot_on_the_table.source: instrument 2 on the i1iO 2 table, 48 of 48 patches
dual_spot_on_the_table.chromiq_differs: ChromIQ reads the UV half at the lamp half's integration (the one its own calibration read the tile with the UV LED at): the recordings show the UV-tile level per unit of integration the same at 139, 1183, 1440 and 1443 clocks, so the exposure rule (calibration = reading, per light source) holds either way
